A countdown of the life you have left, on your phone. It runs down always.

Hold two phones back to back and time starts moving between them: the one held
screen up takes, the one below loses. The rate doubles every second the contact
is held — breaking it is the only way out from under the speed.

**You need** Android 10 or newer with NFC, Telegram installed, and a second
phone running the same app. Twenty-five years are issued once per Telegram
account, so reinstalling returns the balance rather than resetting it.

**Installing.** Download the APK below and open it. Android asks for permission
to install from unknown sources, granted to whatever app you open it from. Play
Protect warns about the build: it is signed with the project's own key, not
distributed through Google Play. [Obtainium](https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium)
can watch these releases for you.
